authorization_text: I approve the separately recorded recovery baseline
scope: One separately recorded recovery baseline; unchanged frozen tests, model, evaluator, acceptance criteria, and original cumulative limits. No authorization for another recovery, automatic retry, merge, release, or support-boundary expansion.
comparison_policy: The original interrupted run remains separately reported, with no capability score. The approved recovery cohort supplies baseline design outcomes if complete; recovery attempts are labeled as such and cannot be represented as uninterrupted first-workflow successes. No case or criterion is removed.
implementation_policy: No production changes before a recovery-baseline-driven scope decision demonstrating a credible path to two distinct complete uplifts under at most three generic fixes. Reserved cases remain excluded from implementation tuning.
